crossRefs.note: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.
I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.
For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of…
“For these things I weep. My eye, my eye runs down with water, because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far…
My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”

translations.web: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.
translations.bsb: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;
translations.kjv: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
translations.asv: My face is red with weeping, And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
